name: Wait for f64 oracle
command:
P=luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net
while ssh -o BatchMode=yes $P 'pgrep -f q2_0_ref_f64.py > /dev/null'; do sleep 60; done
echo "=== f64 oracle finished ==="
ssh -o BatchMode=yes $P 'grep -c "^ARGMAX" /tmp/oracle8_f64.log; echo "--- f64 argmaxes"; grep "^ARGMAX" /tmp/oracle8_f64.log; echo "--- f32 argmaxes"; grep "^ARGMAX" /tmp/oracle8.log; echo "--- logit deltas f32 vs f64"; python3 - <<"PY"
import re
def logits(path):
    d={}
    for l in open(path):
        if not l.startswith("LOGITS"): continue
        p=int(l.split()[1][1:]); m=[(int(x.split(":")[0]),float(x.split(":")[1])) for x in l.split()[2:]]
        d[p]=dict(m)
    return d
a=logits("/tmp/oracle8.log"); b=logits("/tmp/oracle8_f64.log")
for p in sorted(set(a)&set(b)):
    common=set(a[p])&set(b[p])
    if not common: continue
    mx=max(abs(a[p][k]-b[p][k]) for k in common)
    print("p%d  max|f32-f64| over shared top-5 = %.5f"%(p,mx))
PY'
